<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-LIC-007</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Licence</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>The **License** page</b></div></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Failed to activate license. Please check your license key.</span></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Invalid license key format. License key must be in INVE format (INVE-TYPE-XXXX-XXXX-...).</span></div>

## Why it happens

- The key was not pasted completely, or spaces or line breaks were added.
- The machine cannot reach the licence server `https://license.invenia.in`.
- The key is already active on another machine.

## Fix it

1. Paste the whole key, starting with `INVE-`.
2. Check that this machine can open `https://license.invenia.in`. Activation needs internet access once; a proxy or a laptop connection is enough.
3. If the key is active on another machine, deactivate it there first.

## Check that it worked

The **License** page shows the licence as active.
